status: PASS fixture; observational balance evidence, acceptance incomplete
build: Release net10.0 from genuine current-main checkout plus verified PR09 overlay

conditions.movementSelection: pre-load MatchDefinition Native/Momentum rule; diagnostics enabled only for Momentum
conditions.spawn: unchanged seeded native spawn (Rng1 8128, Rng2 0x8128a5a5); 120 native idle settling ticks after introduction End
conditions.jumpSchedule: jump-only Space on tick1; manual-hop-chain Space on tick1 then every stationary Native firstLandingTick; W on every other chain tick. Both models receive identical fixed input ticks; no automatic landing buffer
conditions.coastSchedule: W ticks1-80; all movement released ticks81-240; no jump
conditions.units: speed = length(native planar Speed) * 30 in world units/second; each native simulation step is 1/60 second
conditions.objectives: first tick reaching planar radial displacement 3/6/10 world units from actual spawn; same objective per pair. Null time means not reached in bounded trial (collision can obstruct route); path distance also reported and is not objective displacement
conditions.jumpEvidence: MomentumLegalJumpTicks uses same-frame nativeJumpAccepted ContactPhase seam with exact native Hunter jump impulse; InferredUpwardJumpPressTicks requires a fresh UsedJump flag plus post-collision upward-velocity increase, explicitly not proof of Native accepted jumps
conditions.sourceIdentity: record source SHA/dirty diff, CPU and build flags in the invoking evidence manifest

limitations: Windows x64 headless offline single-player fixed60Hz simulation, no physical-device/render/network/competitive-balance acceptance.
Manual chain here starts immediately from rest; both models receive identical fixed input ticks. This is not a running-start speed-envelope sweep.

Native moving accepted-jump counts are not directly instrumented; fresh UsedJump plus upward jump-press samples are explicitly inferred. Momentum accepted jump counts use nativeJumpAccepted at actual horizontal solver seam.
Objective times are first reaching fixed planar radial displacement from same native spawn/facing, not cumulative path distance. Null times are right-censored within trial duration.
No profile tuning or threshold changed and no observed timing establishes performance acceptance.
